architecture_proposed.fit_only_normalization: two purpose-specific mean/standard-deviation transforms, shared across D arms
architecture_proposed.codebook: one shared full-vector 16-dimensional codebook with 1024 centroids; one 10-bit categorical code per recipient
architecture_proposed.code_assignment: minimum squared Euclidean distance, lowest-index tie
architecture_proposed.head: 16 decoded coordinates -> 64 GELU -> purpose class logits
architecture_proposed.vq_fit: Adam 0.001, batch 256, 20 epochs, final iterate; task CE + 0.5 KL(Ucal teacher||head) + beta_rec normalized reconstruction; D_VQ_JOINT beta_rec=0.25 and adds lambda=1 times mean of exact local1/local2 1024-cell hard-ID one-hot SEX frequency squared differences and a fixed 128-feature factorized Rademacher pair-ID sketch squared difference; task-only grid beta_rec={0,0.25,1}, no SEX objective; hard one-hot forward with temperature-1 distance-softmax straight-through backward to codebook C; frozen h is never updated
architecture_proposed.privacy_objective_random_features: Two seeded independent 1024x128 Rademacher sign tables for aligned pair IDs; local one-hot terms are exact and have no sketch. Pair sketch has a nullspace and requires fresh direct pair-ID attack.
architecture_proposed.assignment_churn_diagnostic: Count fit/inner people whose hard IDs changed from seeded k-means initialization; a decoded-vector move without hard-ID change is a failed protection mechanism check.
architecture_proposed.calibration: one fixed held-out global temperature per task/arm/source seed, no grid

arms_per_source_seed.open_identity: Admit the historical OSF_DEFENSE_FIT RAW-J beta 0.3 purpose encoders by source-model hashes and role-only forward pass; retrain equal D heads on permitted role features and recalibrate. If source identity or exact feature contract fails, this control is INCOMPLETE; no new raw training is silently substituted.

per_source_seed_learning_counts.exact_alias_rule: Call controls_fit.prepare_control_cache once per source seed on identical permitted fit rows: one pooled KMeans plus one purpose-specific KMeans each. Pass its same pooled (normalizer,centers) initializer to D_VQ_JOINT and all three task-only train_d calls, and pass its same normalizer/purpose tensors to LOCAL, SEQ12, SEQ21, UNCHANGED and LEACE. The ten logical VQ initializations therefore use three physical KMeans fits and seven exact cache aliases. If this wiring or complete cache identity is absent, record all actual KMeans/normalizer refits instead; similar deterministic outputs are not aliases. No model-training output is aliased.
per_source_seed_learning_counts.note: Each VQ training fit contains its head. Local and sequential stages are separately charged. PurposeNormalizer.fit is one physical call that estimates two purpose transformations for D; RAW-J likewise has one physical feature-normalizer call estimating two purpose transformations. Arm-level normalizer_fits counts above denote estimated purpose transformations, not physical calls. Charge CPU once per physical call. RAW-J source encoder/checkpoint and preprocessing are historical aliases only after S2/S4 hash admission; two new heads and calibration fits are charged.
